metadata.description: Excursion Example B: +12V, BK100, 600 W OPL-MAX. A card that genuinely needs the full 3x short-interval excursion allowance permitted by Base Specification Section 10.1.4, and therefore declares it rather than understating it. This is the case the validation rules have to permit: every ratio sits at or just under the Section 10.1.4 envelope, so the declaration is legal but leaves the platform no headroom to assume. Declaring the ceiling is a useful statement in its own right, because it is a verified claim rather than the absence of one. This file is pretty-printed for review. A real CID is minified.
